title: 第二十章 大统领自缢第二十一章 吞噬升级
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: “参见陛下！”
鼠王窃耳一走进殿中就跪下行礼，他的头上顶着一对雪白的大耳朵，银发披散，五官精巧灵秀，一双碧绿色的眼中闪烁着幽光。
“窃耳，不知你求见朕，所为何事？”
窃耳眼珠一转，抬手指向国师身旁的禁卫军大统领。
“启禀陛下，臣要举报大统领，他私通北狄，臣这里有他藏起来的书信。”
说完，从袖中掏出一叠厚厚的书信递给内侍。
“陛下，微臣冤枉！”
见鼠王窃耳举报自己通敌，大统领急忙跪倒在地。
昭武帝接过内侍递过来的书信匆匆扫了几眼，随后将书信用力甩到大统领面前，冷声下令。
“大统领私通北狄，有与北狄王来往书信为证，朕心甚寒，着禁卫军锁拿入狱，诛九族！”
“陛下，臣是冤枉的，这些书信臣可以解释……”大统领慌忙解释，只是还没吐出几个字就被禁卫军上前锁住。
太子萧世安第一个从班列里走出，明黄色朝服扫过金砖：“父皇息怒！大统领曾戍边十年，三破北狄，断不会通敌，还请父皇彻查之后再定罪！”
话音刚落，于太保也跟着走出来，黑色的铠甲咔咔作响：“太子所言极是！大统领由老臣一手提拔，他忠心耿耿……”
话音未落，昭武帝猛地一拍御案，白玉镇纸滚落在地，碎成两半。
“够了！”他的怒声响彻殿顶，“你们俩一个是储君，一个是太保，都要为逆贼说情？”
“白纸黑字写的明明白白，太子，你仁柔无断，心慈手软，真是让朕太失望了！”
“父皇息怒！”
太子萧世安跪伏在地，一张俊脸涨得通红。
“陛下息怒！”
听到昭武帝在朝堂上直接表达对太子萧世安的不满，玉阶下的文武百官全部跪了下来。
昭武帝看着玉阶下的百官伏成一片黑，心中一紧，目光扫过伏在地上的萧世安，突然话锋一转：“太子，既然你说大统领是冤枉的，朕便给你这个机会，这案子，交给你彻查，看你能查出什么来。”
萧世安领旨，当夜就提审了鼠王窃耳，大统领还有禁卫军的六位领兵。
窃耳一口咬死书信是大统领的书房里搜出来的，完全不把萧世安放在眼里。
大统领一脸悔恨：“太子殿下，臣年轻时在外游历，经过北狄时与北狄王一见如故，结拜为兄弟，时常有书信来往。后来入朝为官后，臣与北狄王断了来往，书信也被封存起来。”
“臣没想到，鼠王窃耳如此神通广大，竟然把这些书信都翻了出来。”
“我相信你，这件事我一定会给父皇解释清楚。”
萧世安郑重承诺。
第二日，萧世安将找好的证据呈给昭武帝。看到那些书信确实有了些年代，昭武帝心里信了几分。
萧世安又道：“父皇，儿臣还有一条铁证，这书信用的纸是早年的洒金纸，纸张比现在的薄很多，这种工艺十年前就已经失传。”
昭武帝闻言，再次拿起手里的书信仔细查看。萧世安见此，又把近十年每一年大昭造纸坊出品的洒金纸拿给他看。
content_en:
"See Your Majesty!"
The Mouse King Tao Er knelt down and saluted as soon as he entered the palace. He had a pair of big snow-white ears on his head, his silver hair was loose, his facial features were delicate and graceful, and his green eyes were shining with a faint light.
"Tie'er, I wonder why you want to see me?"
Tie'er rolled his eyes and raised his hand to point at the commander of the Imperial Guard next to the Imperial Guard.
"Your Majesty, I want to report to the commander-in-chief that he has an affair with Beidi. I have the letters he has hidden here."
After speaking, he took out a thick stack of letters from his sleeve and handed it to the chamberlain.
"Your Majesty, I am wronged!"
Seeing the Rat King whispering that he was collaborating with the enemy, the commander hurriedly knelt on the ground.
Emperor Zhaowu took the letter handed over by his chamberlain and glanced at it hurriedly, then threw the letter in front of the commander-in-chief with all his strength and gave the order in a cold voice.
"The commander-in-chief has an affair with Beidi. There are letters between him and the king of Beidi as evidence. I am very heartbroken. I will imprison you with the lock of the Imperial Guard and punish the nine tribes!"
"Your Majesty, I was wronged. These scribes can explain..." The commander hurriedly explained, but before he could utter a few words, the imperial guards stepped forward and locked him.
Prince Xiao Shi'an was the first to walk out of the train, his bright yellow court uniform sweeping the gold bricks: "Father, please calm down! The commander-in-chief has guarded the border for ten years and defeated Beidi three times. He will definitely not collaborate with the enemy. Please investigate thoroughly before convicting him!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Yu Taibao also walked out, his black armor rattling: "What the prince said is absolutely true! The commander-in-chief was promoted by an old minister, and he is loyal..."
Before he finished speaking, Emperor Zhaowu slammed the imperial case, and the white jade paperweight rolled to the ground and broke into two halves.
"That's enough!" His angry voice echoed from the top of the palace, "You two are the crown prince and the Taibao, and you both want to intercede for the traitor?"
"It's clearly written in black and white on the paper. Prince, you are kind and gentle. I'm really disappointed!"
"Father, calm down!"
Prince Xiao Shian knelt on the ground, his handsome face flushed.
"Your Majesty, calm down!"
Hearing Emperor Zhaowu directly express his dissatisfaction with Prince Xiao Shian in the court, all the civil and military officials under the jade steps knelt down.
Emperor Zhaowu watched the officials crouched in darkness under the jade steps, and his heart tightened. He glanced at Xiao Shi'an who was lying on the ground, and suddenly changed the topic: "Prince, since you said that the commander-in-chief was unjust, I will give you this opportunity. I will leave this case to you for a thorough investigation and see what you can find out."
Xiao Shi'an accepted the order and interrogated the Rat King Tao Er that night, as well as the commander-in-chief and six leaders of the Imperial Guard.
Tie'er bit the letter and found it in the commander's study, and did not take Xiao Shi'an seriously at all.
The commander-in-chief looked remorseful: "Your Highness, I traveled abroad when I was young. When I passed through Beidi, I hit it off with the King of Beidi. They became brothers and we often exchanged letters. Later, after I entered the court and became an official, I broke off all contact with the King of Beidi, and the letters were sealed."
"I didn't expect that Rat King Tao Er was so powerful that he could even dig out all these letters."
"I believe you, I will definitely explain this matter to my father."
Xiao Shian solemnly promised.
On the second day, Xiao Shian presented the evidence he had found to Emperor Zhaowu. Seeing that those letters were indeed dated, Emperor Zhaowu felt somewhat convinced.
Xiao Shi'an added: "Father, I have a piece of ironclad evidence. The paper used for this book is gold-sprinkled paper from the early years. The paper is much thinner than today. This craft was lost ten years ago."
After hearing this, Emperor Zhaowu picked up the letter in his hand and looked at it carefully. Seeing this, Xiao Shi'an showed him the gold-sprinkled paper produced by Dazhao Paper Mill every year in the past ten years.
